title: androsace chamaejasme var. lehmanniana
intro: Androsace chamaejasme var. lehmanniana, commonly known as Himalayan Rock Jasmine or Lehmann's Alpine Rose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to calm the nervous system, relax muscles, and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of Androsace chamaejasme var. lehmanniana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
